capabilities: Evaluate calculation expressions with operator precedence in sigma code blocks
Compute block totals and hierarchy subtotals automatically
Assign variables and reference earlier lines in later expressions
Apply built-in scientific functions such as sin, cos, and clamp
Render evaluated blocks as HTML tables with number formatting and syntax coloring
disambiguation: Not a spreadsheet application; calculations live in sigma code blocks within a note rather than in editable grid cells.
extras: Results render only after the editing cursor leaves the block or reading mode is switched on; README covers desktop and mobile support.
problem: Obsidian notes have no built-in way to run arithmetic or multi-line calculations inside a note, forcing users to leave the app or use external tools.
summary: Calculation-sheet plugin that evaluates line-by-line expressions in sigma code blocks and renders results with totals as HTML tables.
